BBox.description: A box in image pixels: top-left corner, width and height (also ``sd_detect.BBox``).
BBox.title: BBox

Candidate.description: A place where something that may be a person was seen. One row per revision.
Candidate.title: Candidate

CandidateAssessment.description:
One engine's view of a candidate against one profile version.

The model fills only ``person``, ``person_p``, ``fields``, ``overall`` and
``explanation_sv``; the code fills the rest. Field keys follow ``FIELD_KEY_PATTERN``;
unknown keys are dropped. ``flags`` mark claims nobody can check from a still (that
someone moves, or who they are): the panel shows them as unverified.
CandidateAssessment.title: CandidateAssessment

CandidateBatch.description: Revisions written in one transaction: all or none.
CandidateBatch.title: CandidateBatch

CandidateRevision.description:
A new candidate (``base_rev`` 0) or the next revision of one, from the search
service. It may set ``new``, ``assessing``, ``ready`` or ``merged``; ``state`` None keeps
the state in force (a candidate a person or the pilot holds). Confirmed and rejected
are a person's and are refused here (E1).
CandidateRevision.title: CandidateRevision

LastSeen.description: The initial planning point (IPP): where and when the person was last seen.
LastSeen.title: LastSeen

ProbabilityMapInputs.description:
What the map is computed from besides the profile and the stills: the charter's
area and sectors, the operator's areas, and the latest stored version.
ProbabilityMapInputs.title: ProbabilityMapInputs

ProbabilityMapWrite.description:
``sd-search`` -> ground: a new version. ``p_z`` and ``pod_z`` are base64 of
zlib-compressed little-endian float32 arrays of ``grid.nx * grid.ny`` values; the
ground checks the sizes, that every value is finite and in [0, 1], and the sum.
ProbabilityMapWrite.title: ProbabilityMapWrite

SearchArea.description: An area the operator drew with a hint for the map.
SearchArea.title: SearchArea

SearchDetection.description: A stored detection of a target class, as the search service reads it.
SearchDetection.title: SearchDetection

SearchHeartbeat.description:
``cloud``: ``off`` (not configured), ``ok`` or ``down`` (matching paused: the cloud
failed or the budget is spent; only the code assesses).
SearchHeartbeat.title: SearchHeartbeat

SearchProfile.description:
What the person looked like, as the operator approved it.

A proposal from the AI has ``approved_by = None`` and is never used for matching.
SearchProfile.title: SearchProfile

SearchStill.description: A still the drone took, as the map needs it: where it looked and how well.
SearchStill.title: SearchStill

SearchTrack.description: A candidate in force with everything fusion needs to resume after a restart.
SearchTrack.title: SearchTrack

SectorScore.description:
One sector of the charter on the current map.

``poa``: the chance the person is in the sector now (cells whose centre lies in it).
``covered_pct``: the share of its cells seen with a POD of at least 0.1.
``mean_pod``: the mean cumulative POD over its cells.
``pos_plan``: the chance of finding the person if the sector is surveyed once more as
planned. ``psr``: ``pos_plan`` per minute of planned flight (higher first).
SectorScore.title: SectorScore
